articles.summary: Oceaneering wins a five-year asset integrity and inspection services contract in Qatar, strengthening its long-term asset integrity presence in the region.
articles.title: Oceaneering Wins Five-Year Asset Integrity Contract in Qatar

articles.summary: Oceaneering has secured a Petrobras contract to provide ROV services offshore Brazil, supporting subsea operations with fieldwork set to begin in 2027.
articles.title: Oceaneering Secures Petrobras Contract for ROV Services Offshore Brazil
